name: Expanse CMS
shortDescription: A UK-managed website platform for Catholic parishes, religious orders and other Christian communities, with hosting, maintenance and ChurchSuite connection options.
suitableContexts: Catholic parishes or Christian communities wanting a managed website rather than a self-hosted CMS
Churches using ChurchSuite that want public events, rotas or sign-up forms reflected on their website

pricing.summary: The supplier advertises managed plans from £29 per month, with its main website describing the service as starting from £59 per month. Ask for the exact plan, onboarding scope, VAT and renewal terms in writing before purchase.

startingPrice.qualifier: Starter plan shown on the supplier pricing section

tiers.label: Starter
tiers.detail: Supplier-published entry plan; confirm the included scope and availability

tiers.label: Managed website service
tiers.detail: Headline price on the supplier home page; described as managed with unlimited pages and users

dataHosting: The supplier describes managed hosting, daily backups, SSL, uptime monitoring and security updates. Ask for the hosting provider and region, data-processing agreement and sub-processor list.
gdprInformation: The supplier publishes general UK GDPR guidance for churches. This profile has not located supplier terms, a privacy notice for the service or a data-processing agreement, so a church should obtain and review those before using forms or integrations that process personal data.
coreFeatures: Unlimited pages and users according to the supplier
Managed hosting, SSL, backups and security updates
Mass times, events and newsletter publishing
ChurchSuite event, rota and form connections
integrations: ChurchSuite: supplier describes live event and Mass-time synchronisation, embedded sign-up forms and rota display
importExport: Supplier states that full content export is available on request
support: Onsite training stated by the supplier for ChurchSuite integration

uk-purchasing.value: The product identifies Little Polar Apps Ltd as its operating company; Companies House records company number 07634927 in England and Wales.

managed-service.value: Supplier describes managed hosting, daily backups, SSL, uptime monitoring and security updates as part of the website service.

churchsuite-connection.value: Supplier describes ChurchSuite event and Mass-time synchronisation, embedded sign-up forms and rota display.

editorial.assessment: Expanse CMS is a newer, UK-managed website offer with a particularly clear parish and Catholic focus. It may suit a church that wants a named person to handle the technical platform rather than assembling WordPress hosting and volunteer maintenance, but it should be evaluated as a managed service: contract, ownership, data terms, accessibility and exit arrangements matter as much as the visual result.
bestFor: Catholic parishes and Christian communities seeking a managed website service
Churches that value ChurchSuite-connected public event and form workflows
Small teams without a technical volunteer to maintain hosting and updates
strengths: Public material is specifically framed around UK parish needs, including Mass times, safeguarding information and newsletters
Supplier publishes entry pricing and describes an all-in managed service
The operating company and UK company registration are identifiable
limitations: Ask the supplier about Service terms, data-processing agreement, sub-processors, hosting region and retention terms
The published £29 entry plan and £59 managed-service headline need a written scope and renewal quote
A managed website still needs local ownership of content accuracy, accessibility and safeguarding information

procurementVerdict.problem: Maintaining a credible parish or church website without a technical owner
procurementVerdict.differentiator: A parish-focused managed CMS with ChurchSuite connection options and direct supplier support
procurementVerdict.firstCheck: Request a written proposal that defines plan scope, content ownership, accessibility responsibilities, data terms and export arrangements
